en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Mansour Bin Hazim, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the emancipation of the women. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Emancipate one who can be self-sufficient herself’.
